strengths: Pixal3D 4-view runs (mv4_gemfix_s42, s7) lock in the 0.40 depth/height ratio, avoiding the front-to-back stretching seen in single-view and Hunyuan runs.
Watertight 1-component remeshing in r2post runs eliminates internal geometry noise that ruins 64px outline generation in baseline_trellismac_s7.
mv4_gemfix_s42 achieves the cleanest separation between the top red bow and the spherical hair bun in side and isometric silhouettes.
t2cpp_512_gemA768_s7_r2post produces the sharpest geometric creases on the high collar, corset, and skirt hem.
Multi-view texture projection in Pixal3D preserves readable color blocks for the brown corset, red dress, and skin tones at 64px.
weaknesses: Katana geometry fails across all runs: it turns into a thick plank in mv4 runs, bends or disappears in baselines, and completely misses the crescent hook guard.
Remeshing fuses thin sheets (pink ribbons, collar edges, sleeve cuffs) into thick, blobby masses that muddy the 64px silhouette.
t2cpp_512_gemA768_s7_r2post suffers from catastrophic texture darkening, making its direct sprite output unusable without re-projecting colors.
sv_gemBun_s42 hallucinates a massive floor-length ponytail (0.91 depth/height), completely breaking the character's profile and back views.
Facial features in Pixal3D remeshes are overly recessed and noisy, causing dark shadows over the eyes and mouth at 64px.
Legs, ankle straps, and heels lack crisp geometric definition, merging into soft cylinders in the remeshed outputs.
tuning_suggestions: Erase the katana and ribbons from the 2D turnaround views before 3D generation; attach procedural weapon and ribbon meshes in Blender afterward.
Fix the lighting/albedo bug in the t2cpp_512 pipeline, or project the mv4_gemfix_s42 textures onto the sharper t2cpp_512 geometry.
Flatten the face normal map or use unlit/flat-shaded albedo for the head region during sprite rendering to prevent eye-socket shadowing at 64px.
Use 4-view inputs strictly; drop single-view and 2-view pipelines to prevent depth hallucinations and doubled buns.
